subject: Re: Air freight quote request – RUH and GRU
body:
Thank you for your offer. Both prices work for us. Please go ahead and book the first shipment now; we will confirm the second shipment later.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer accepts the quoted price for the first shipment and asks us to book it now.
